hero.intro: Hosted by Chris Hemmings and clinical psychologist Dr Jett Stone, No Man’s an Island is a podcast about men’s mental health, relationships and the issues affecting men and boys today. Chris brings his experience as a therapist and coach to candid conversations with researchers, therapists, campaigners and people with lived experience. Together, the hosts explore subjects such as anxiety, shame, grief, addiction and fatherhood, making space for honest perspectives and new ideas.

about:
_No Man’s an Island_ is a men’s mental health podcast.

Through honest conversations with researchers, therapists, campaigners and people with lived experience, they explore anxiety, relationships, grief, identity, fatherhood and the pressures shaping men’s lives.

The aim is to make space for thoughtful, grounded conversations that help us better understand men’s experiences and what support can look like.

**Explore the episodes:** [No Man’s an Island on Men’s Therapy Hub](https://menstherapyhub.com/podcast/)

[Chris Hemmings](https://chrishemmings.co.uk/) is a British therapist and coach who works only with male clients. He’s the founder of both [Men’s Therapy Hub](https://menstherapyhub.co.uk/) and [M-Path](https://m-path.co.uk/). Before training to be a therapist he was a BBC journalist and wrote the book ‘Be a Man’.

[Dr. Jett Stone](https://www.jettstonephd.com/) is an American clinical psychologist who specialises in working with men. He’s the author of the book ‘[Quiet Your Mind: A Men’s Guide](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/768720/quiet-your-mind-a-mens-guide-by-jett-stone-phd/)‘ and has been featured in CNN, The New York Times, The Guardian, and Fortune.
